title: The flag up, third
logline: The mailbox with its flag up in early December, the third time in the private pages, and this year the page draws the envelope's corner in the box's mouth: cream, thick. Where it goes: reserved. That it's thick: the page.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox in December with its red flag raised and its door ajar, the corner of a thick cream envelope showing, rain, an empty road.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox in December with its red flag raised and its door ajar showing the corner of a thick cream envelope, rain and an empty road, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
